newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Heidemij seeks merger with DHV.
newsitem.headline: Heidemij seeks merger with DHV.

text.p: Dutch engineering consultancy Heidemij said on Tuesday it was in talks with sector rival DHV on forging a fully-blown merger.

"The intent is to complete the transaction on the basis of an exchange of shares. In order to make this possible Heidemij will place 5.25 million new shares (with) the DHV Foundation, the present shareholder of DHV Beheer BV," Heidemij said in a statement.
Heidemij said the proposed new company would operate under the name of DHV Heidemij in the Netherlands but on international markets, the DHV label would be used.

The merger would lead to a multi-disciplinary engineering consultancy with around 8,300 employees and an estimated gross revenue of over 1.4 billion guilders ($814.9 million) , half of which would be generated outside the Netherlands.
"The intended merger offers better opportunity for development of new technologies and more capacity and skills to handle larger, more complex projects," the company said. ($ = 1.718 Dutch Guilders)
